title: Bimodal Destiny

canonical_node.axiom: There are exactly two stable eternal destinies for a soul: maximal coherence (heaven) and minimal coherence (hell). No intermediate stable state exists.
definitions: C: coherence measure of a soul's alignment with God.

plain_summary: This document argues that there are only two eternal destinies - heaven and hell - based on a mathematical theorem about coherence dynamics. It claims that intermediate states are unstable and that the soul's moral sign is fixed after death. However, the proof is not formally verified and relies on theological assumptions.
